results.name: Kuzhine 02
results.description:
Cabinets & Appliances: The cabinetry is high-gloss beige with handleless doors, creating a sleek look. Included are a built-in oven and microwave, an under-mount sink, and a modern stainless steel range hood with a curved glass canopy over glass shelving.

Dining Area: A prominent Calacatta Viola marble dining table with striking purple/burgundy veining extends from the kitchen island, featuring a waterfall edge that meets the light wood plank floor. It is paired with four matching curved light wood bistro-style chairs.

Lighting & Atmosphere: The scene is bathed in warm, dramatic, late-afternoon sunlight from a large window to the right (out of view), which casts strong, artistic diagonal window grid shadows across the cabinetry and walls.

Decor & Context: On the far right, a large potted fiddle-leaf fig tree stands. On the kitchen counter, there are olive oil bottles and a small herb plant; a folded towel is on the dining table. The overall style is luxurious and contemporary.
